test_title: Arithmetical and Numerical Ability Mock Test 22

questions.question: Arnav can complete an assignment in 8 days, while Manya can complete it in 11 days. They work on alternate days, starting with Arnav. After following this pattern for 7 days, Arnav leaves, and Manya continues the work alone. How many more days will Manya need to finish the remaining part of the assignment?
The population of a village was 2,10,000. It increased by 15% in the first year and increased by 30% in the second year. Its population after two years is _______.
The average of three numbers is 20. If two numbers are 12 and 29, the third number is:
During a sale, Raghav bought a notebook marked for ₹12 at a 25% discount and a pen marked for ₹100 at an 85% discount. How much (in ₹) did he save due to the sale?
A bus is moving at a speed of 31 km/hr. If its speed is reduced by 83%, the new speed of the bus (in km/hr) will be:
The sum of two numbers is 329 and their HCF is 47. Which of the options given below can be a possible pair of such numbers?
Find the simple interest (in ₹) if a sum of ₹400 is borrowed for 9.5 years at 16% per annum rate of interest.
The present cost of an apartment is ₹101619. After a year, its cost increased to ₹125530. The percentage increase (rounded off to the nearest integer) in the cost of the apartment is:
If the length of a cuboid is 49 cm, its breadth is 13 cm, and the volume of the cuboid is 5096 cm3, then find the height of the cuboid (in cm).
The distance between two points on a map is 8 cm. The scale of the map is 1 : 379792. The actual distance (rounded off to two decimal places) between the two points (in km) is:

A rectangular floor is to be tiled using square tiles. The length of the floor is 12 metres, and the width is 15 metres. What is the least number of square tiles required to cover the entire floor if each tile is of the largest possible size that fits perfectly?
The average weight of Akshay, Atul and Baban is 45 kg. If the average weight of Akshay and Atul is 37 kg and that of Atul and Baban is 47 kg, then the weight of Atul (in kg) is:

Mohit walks to his friend's house 6 km away from home. In the morning, he covers the distance in 5.5 hours whereas, while returning home in the evening, he takes 60 more minutes to cover the same distance. Find his average speed (in km/hr) during the two-way journey.
Naresh invested ₹44,800 at 10% p.a. for 1 year at compound interest, compounded half-yearly. The amount received by him after 1 year is:

Arvind bought an article for ₹x. He sold it to Biru at a loss of 15%. Biru spent ₹188 on its transportation and sold it to Minu at a profit of 52%. If Minu bought it for ₹1,216, then what is the value of x?

A started a business with a capital of ₹1,53,000. After 6 months, B joined him with a certain amount of capital. At the end of a year of A's starting the business, the profit was shared in the ratio 6 : 2. How much (in ₹) did B invest?
The average of the marks of 13 students in a class is 60. If the marks of each student are doubled, what will be the new average?
At what rate (in percentage) per annum on simple interest will a sum of money be 2 times of itself in 8 years?
In a race of 400 m, the ratio of speeds of two contestants Amit and Aman is 7 : 9. If Amit has a head start of 190 m, then Amit wins by:
The price of a commodity has increased by 24%. By what per cent (rounded off to the nearest integer) should it be decreased to restore the original price?
